test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The difference between the current ages of two brothers is 4 years. Twenty years ago, the age of the elder brother was 1.25 times the age of the younger brother. What is the current age (in years) of the elder brother?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age difference between two people is always constant = 4 years.

20 years ago, ratio (Elder : Younger) = 1.25 : 1 = 5 : 4.

Ratio difference = 5 − 4 = 1 unit → 4 years.

Elder age (20 years ago) = 5 × 4 = 20 years.

Current age of Elder = 20 + 20 = 40 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Current difference (E − Y) = 4 years.

20 years ago, Elder age = 1.25 × Younger age.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f910b581578955fb5fd5f5020a744725138d138c779b623dced422aa1a91417.png] 

Let current age of Elder brother be E and Younger be Y.

Formula: Ageₚₐₛₜ = Age꜀ᵤᵣᵣₑₙₜ − Timeᵢₙₜₑᵣvₐₗ

⇒ E − Y = 4

⇒ Y = E − 4

20 years ago:

⇒ (E − 20) = 1.25 × (Y − 20)

⇒ E − 20 = 1.25 × (E − 4 − 20)

⇒ E − 20 = 1.25 × (E − 24)

⇒ E − 20 = 1.25E − 30

⇒ 30 − 20 = 1.25E − E

⇒ 10 = 0.25E

⇒ E = 10 / 0.25

⇒ E = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals remains the same throughout their lives, regardless of how many years pass.

Decimal to Ratio Conversion

Converting multipliers to fractions (e.g., 1.25 = 5/4, 1.5 = 3/2, 1.75 = 7/4) simplifies the Unitary Method for solving age problems.

Future/Past Age Calculation

If current age is X, age after n years is X + n, and age n years ago was X − n.
